title: Earn ₹1,000 on Every Loan Disbursal
subtitle: Get cash rewards on every single loan disbursed by your referred partners.
description: Earn rewards on every loan file! Whenever any partner you invited completes a loan disbursement for their customer, you receive cash rewards directly credited to your account. You earn on every disbursal, not just the first one!
terms: Earn cash rewards on every verified partner disbursed loan file.

title: Build Lifetime Network Earnings
subtitle: Every partner joins your network permanently, generating ongoing benefits.
description: Expand your partner network with DSAs, loan agents, and financial consultants. As they grow their business, your referral earnings grow with them.
terms: No cap on the number of partners you can refer.

title: Instant Verification & Fast Payouts
subtitle: Transparent ledger tracking with direct bank account payouts upon approval.
description: Track all your referred partners, application milestones, and earnings in real-time. Approved referral rewards are disbursed quickly without hassle.
terms: Requires active partner KYC and verified bank account.

title: Special Referral Milestone Bonuses
subtitle: Unlock exclusive tier upgrades and high-value rewards as your invites disburse more.
description: Reach referral milestones each month to unlock extra commission slabs, performance badges, and priority RM support.
terms: Calculated based on monthly partner network performance.
